name: Improved Filter Options
author: Brandon
description:
A clipboard for filter settings. COPY the settings (materials, allow/block) of any placed filter - Mk.1, Mk.2, Mk.3 or a filter wall - and PASTE them onto another placed filter row, or use them for every new filter you place next. It works across kinds: copy a Mk.2, paste onto a Mk.3, and back. The clipboard is kept by material name, so it survives reloads and moving to another PC.

HOW
The Filter clipboard panel (drag it by its title) has: COPY - then click a placed filter to copy its settings; PASTE - then click a placed filter to give that whole row the copied settings; NEW FILTERS - make the next Mk.2 / Mk.3 filters you place take the copied settings (copying does this automatically); CLEAR. Esc or right-click cancels a copy/paste.

enabled.descriptionKey: Turn the filter clipboard panel off without unsubscribing.

copyAlsoSetsNew.descriptionKey: When ON, copying a filter's settings also makes the next Mk.2 / Mk.3 filters you place take them (the same setting the filter panel edits). When OFF, use the NEW FILTERS button for that.
